mapper.select: SELECT u.id as user_id, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, u.password as user_password, ur.role as user_role_role, t.id as task_id, t.title as task_title, t.description as task_description, t.expiration_date as task_expiration_date, t.status as task_status FROM tasklist3.users u LEFT JOIN tasklist3.users_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN tasklist3.users_tasks ut ON u.id = ut.user_id LEFT JOIN tasklist3.tasks t ON ut.task_id = t.id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT u.id as user_id, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, u.password as user_password, ur.role as user_role_role, t.id as task_id, t.title as task_title, t.description as task_description, t.expiration_date as task_expiration_date, t.status as task_status FROM tasklist3.users u LEFT JOIN tasklist3.users_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN tasklist3.users_tasks ut ON u.id = ut.user_id LEFT JOIN tasklist3.tasks t ON ut.task_id = t.id WHERE u.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasklist3.users (name, username, password) VALUES (#{name}, #{username}, #{password})
